For this independent random-concept image test, the coordinator specified an everyday cafe pickup-counter waiting moment. Use the portrait only as visible adult appearance guidance and test a legible pending handoff of a prepared drink, with action, setting, background, and props visible together.

A photorealistic editorial photograph of one adult woman waiting at the pickup counter of a neighborhood cafe in warm early evening. Her visible facial features and long, softly waved dark hair are informed by the supplied portrait. She wears a charcoal knit sweater with sleeves rolled at the wrists. Standing one step back from the customer-side pickup ledge, she holds a phone at chest height in her right hand, its screen showing a simple order number, and glances toward a freshly prepared drink arriving from the service side. A barista behind the counter extends one forearm into the frame and sets a white paper cup with a flat lid on the ledge beside a small wooden sign marked PICKUP. Her left hand rests by her hip, with a clear gap between her and the cup; the drink remains at the handoff point in this suspended moment. A wall-mounted menu board and the working counter form the recognizable cafe background. Warm window light catches the cup rim, her face, and the phone while retaining detail behind the ledge. A standing eye-level three-quarter view includes her face, the phone, both sides of the pickup ledge, the barista forearm, and the complete cup in one frame. Natural skin texture, credible hand geometry, and the quiet rhythm of a routine order pickup make the moment feel observed rather than posed.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
